raw_message.reasoning:
The changes are minimal and focused:

1. Changed `s = parser.add_subparsers()` to `s = parser.add_subparsers(dest="which", required=True)` - This makes a subcommand (compare or bump) mandatory, so when no arguments are provided, argparse will raise SystemExit with code 2 instead of allowing the code to continue and crash with an AttributeError.

2. Changed `sb = parser_bump.add_subparsers(title="Bump commands", dest="bump")` to include `required=True` - This makes a bump type (major/minor/patch/prerelease/build) mandatory when using the bump subcommand, so when `pysemver bump` is called without specifying which bump type, argparse will print the help for the bump subcommand and exit gracefully.
